title: Window Functions: Rankings, Running Totals and LAG
oneLiner: ROW_NUMBER, RANK, DENSE_RANK, LAG and running SUMs: calculations across rows that keep every row.
keyTakeaway: function() OVER (PARTITION BY group ORDER BY order frame) computes across related rows without collapsing them. Rank per group with ROW_NUMBER, RANK or DENSE_RANK depending on ties, compare with neighbours using LAG and LEAD, and filter on a window result in an outer query because windows run after WHERE.
explanation:
Window functions are the most asked-about SQL feature in data and backend interviews, and the cleanest way to answer "top N per group", "running total" and "change since the previous period". They compute over a set of rows related to the current one, but unlike GROUP BY they keep every row.
